name: anchor: organization-api-key
description: Copy of "anchor: organization-api-key" that sends resource_type when it creates a role or permission. It replaces the original once ADR-0022 PR 1 is deployed. Organization API keys: create, read, search, rename, deactivate, expire, validate and introspect (scopes, inactive, expired, deleted, unknown), the 400/401/404/409 cases, no key value echoed on any read, then one final webhook wait proving every create, update and delete emitted its event and nothing else did.
